items.title: Reddit (RDDT) Joins The S&P 500 In A Big Index Milestone
items.summary: Reddit (NYSE:RDDT) is set to be added to the S&P 500 index, making it the second pureplay social media company in the benchmark alongside Meta. The inclusion marks a key milestone for Reddit’s profile with large institutional investors and broad market index funds. Index tracking funds are expected to adjust holdings to reflect Reddit’s addition, which may affect trading volumes and liquidity in the stock.
